_meta.method: Companies House public web pages only (no API key): profile /company/<number> (name, status, type, incorporation/dissolution dates, registered office, SIC, previous-names table), name search /search/companies?q= (incl. 'Matching previous names'), and the alphabetical index /alphabetical-search/get-results?companyName= used to decide exact-name presence (it lists active and dissolved companies and societies, with a status column). Serial, >=1.5 s between requests, pattern from .scratch/tender-db/448-campaign/ch_fetch.py. Keys: 'COH-<number>' = one CH record; 'COH-name:<name>' = what CH holds for that name (found = some CH record currently carries exactly that name after LTD/LIMITED normalisation; linked lists all exact holders, former holders and unmatched neighbours). Registered societies (IP/RS/NP prefixes) have profile pages with name, number and type only; their status is the alphabetical-index status column.
